categories.main_business_segments: Yili Chuanning Biotechnology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, focusing on the production and sales of antibiotic intermediates and synthetic biology products. The company has two main business segments: bio-fermentation technology producing antibiotic intermediates such as thiocyanate erythromycin, 6-APA, 7-ACA, and penicillin G potassium salt; and synthetic biology products including cosmetic raw materials, health product raw materials, and bio-based materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced bio-fermentation technology with a focus on large-scale fermentation, including the world's largest 500m³ fermentation tanks for antibiotic intermediates. It also employs synthetic biology techniques involving gene editing, computational biology for strain design, automated high-throughput strain construction and screening, multi-scale fermentation process optimization, and AI-driven data analysis to enhance strain performance and production efficiency. Environmental technologies for waste treatment and resource recycling are also core to its operations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include antibiotic raw material manufacturers, pharmaceutical formulation producers, and trading companies domestically and internationally. The products serve pharmaceutical industries producing antibiotics such as macrolides, cephalosporins, and penicillins, as well as sectors requiring cosmetic ingredients, health supplements, and bio-based materials. The company’s markets cover China extensively and export to overseas pharmaceutical enterprises and traders.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region, particularly in the Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture and the Horgos Economic Development Zone. It also has a research and development center in Shanghai. Sales cover multiple regions in China including North China, East China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, South China, and Northeast, with export sales to international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yili Chuanning Biotechnology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on the production of antibiotic intermediates and synthetic biology products that serve as key raw materials for downstream pharmaceutical manufacturers. It also engages in upstream activities such as raw material procurement and some agricultural production for fermentation inputs, integrating vertically to some extent.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on a dual-drive development strategy combining bio-fermentation and synthetic biology. It emphasizes innovation through R&D in strain engineering, fermentation process optimization, and AI integration for production and research. The Shanghai Research Institute serves as an innovation hub for synthetic biology CDMO services. The company invests heavily in green technologies, environmental protection, and expanding its product portfolio in high-value natural products, cosmetics, and health ingredients.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of pharmaceutical intermediates and synthetic biology products to pharmaceutical manufacturers and trading companies. The company employs a sales contract model with pricing based on raw material costs, market conditions, and volume discounts. Both domestic direct sales and export sales contribute to revenue, with some sales through intermediaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global player in the bio-fermentation antibiotic intermediate industry, holding a top market share in key products like thiocyanate erythromycin and cephalosporin intermediates. It benefits from high entry barriers including policy restrictions, technical complexity, environmental regulations, capital intensity, and talent requirements. In synthetic biology, it is among the first in China to achieve integrated R&D and large-scale production, competing with emerging domestic and international biotech firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 5.76 billion, a 19.38% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 1.4 billion, up 48.88%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profit margins, and cash flow from operations. It maintains a strong asset base exceeding RMB 10.5 billion and continues to invest in R&D and production capacity expansion, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yili Chuanning Biotechnology emphasizes its unique value proposition through advanced bio-fermentation technology with the largest fermentation scale globally, integrated synthetic biology capabilities, and strong environmental stewardship with leading waste treatment technologies. Its products offer high quality, cost efficiency, and environmental sustainability. The company’s AI-enabled R&D and production processes enhance product performance and reduce costs, differentiating it in the competitive pharmaceutical intermediate and synthetic biology markets.
